description: Données pour le papier: Wellens, J., Kerkhofs, L., Deschaume, O., Putzeys, T., Franceschini, F., Taurino, I., Wagner, P., McLaughlin, M., Verhaert, N., et Bartic, C. (2025). Capteurs et actionneurs B: Produits chimiques, 137789. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.snb.2025.137789 is a dataset listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Catholic University of Leuven. This contains all data used to construct the figures in the paper and supplementary information of: Wellens, J. et al., Hydrogen peroxide sensing with cochlear implants in vivo: Towards intra-operative trauma detection. Sensors and Actuators B: Chemical, 137789. Coverage: Catholic University of Leuven. The portal shows the English title as "Data for paper: Wellens, J., Kerkhofs, L., Deschaume, O., Putzeys, T., Franceschini, F., Taurino, I., Wagner, P., McLaug" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Catholic University of Leuven. Its keywords include Electrochemical sensing, Cochlear implants, Hydrogen peroxide. The listing shows 2025-07-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
